description: This file contains unit tests for the media pipeline miscellaneous functions in the Rialto server media pipeline, using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities such as play, stop, pause, set video window, set/get position, set/get playback rate, render frame, set/get volume, mute, and active request invalidation, primarily by mocking the GStreamer player interface.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, used to test miscellaneous media pipeline functions with setup and teardown for media pipeline creation and destruction.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
methods.description: Constructor that creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the media pipeline.
